titulo.alumno:
«Краткая и полная форма причастия»
Short and long form of the participle

intro: The long form modifies a noun; the short form usually works as a predicate: утверждённый план / план утверждён.

piezas.titulo: The long form modifies a noun; the short form usually works as a predicate: утверждённый план / план утверждён.
texto: The long form modifies a noun; the short form usually works as a predicate: утверждённый план / план утверждён.
The short form agrees in gender and number; in the past, был, была, были appear.

frases.alumno: The commission has taken the decision.
The adopted decision was published in the morning.

pregunta.texto: Which form functions as an attribute in «the adopted decision»?

opciones.explicacion: Принятое directly modifies the noun решение.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Решение принято комиссией.»

opciones.texto: The commission has taken the decision.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The adopted decision was published in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: The adopted decision was published in the morning.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
